---
title: "plot-utils"
---

```{r}
test_results <- read.csv("results/randEVD_comparison.csv",header = T)
```

```{r}
source("../r-utils/plot_utils.R")

library(scales)
library(cowplot)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra) 

col_palette <- hue_pal()(6)
color_map <- c(
  "scikit-learn" = col_palette[1],
  "rsi" = col_palette[2],
  #"rbki" = col_palette[3],
  "nys_rsi" = col_palette[4],
  "nys_rbki" = col_palette[5],
  "exact" = col_palette[6]
)
```

```{r}
for(err in c("rec_error","eig_val_error","eig_vect_error")){
  curr_plot <- grouped_boxplot(
    subset(test_results, decay=="slow" & !(svd %in% c("rbki","nys_rbki"))),
    "accuracy",
    var_name.x = "decay", var_name.y = err,
    group_name = "svd", color_map = color_map, legend = T,
    log.y = T
  ) 
  print(curr_plot)
}
```
